notes: «وَ وَجَدْتُ فِي حَدِيثِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ» is a book's chain: the compiler found the report in Husayn's book, which is written as the first link
«يرفع الحديث إلى» is a gap in the chain (rule 8), written as an unnamed link before the Imam
the Imam «الصادق (ع)» is named after «إلى» and speaks («قال»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 2)
